text:
olivia: Heads up  we had a short enrichment outage 01:22-01:34 UTC; HubSpot workflow routed ~250 leads into the manual fallback queue because `enriched` flag didn't set. Spotted from SDR pings. Snippet: ```POST /vendor/enrich 504 2026-03-30T01:23:11Z payload={vid: 'L-900'} latency=30010ms```

nate: Yikes. Which sources? web only or also campaign forms?

olivia: Mostly web + a small batch from campaign A. All had `source:web` or `utm_source=campaignA`.

raj: Quick mitigation options: A) bump claim_window 5m->10m for overnight B) permissive RR branch when `lead_score>=72` C) backfill fallback queue D) temp SF mapping so owners don't end up as `unassigned`. Which do we run immediately?

nate: Do (C) and (A) now. Backfill first so reps see leads. We can gate (B) behind a toggle if fallback rate stays high.

ops-bot: ops-bot: change request received: set `claim_window_seconds` 300 -> 600 for workspace `marketing-intake` between 00:00-06:00 UTC. Awaiting approval.

olivia: Approved. Also please tag backfill assignments with `hotfix_enrich=true` so we can measure.

leadflow-bot: leadflow-bot: queued backfill (job id bf-20260330-01) dry-run: query=`owner='manual-fallback' AND created_at >= '2026-03-30T01:20:00Z' AND created_at <= '2026-03-30T01:40:00Z'` estimated=251. Proceed? (y/n)

nate: y

leadflow-bot: leadflow-bot: backfill bf-20260330-01 completed. reassigned=247, failed=4 (retry queued). logs: s3://redwood-backfills/bf-20260330-01/logs.txt

raj: I'll add a short alert: `enrichment_failure_rate > 0.004 over 10m` -> page on-call (low). Also adding `fallback_queue_rate` to marketing dashboard.

olivia: Thanks. Plan for tomorrow: vendor SLA review, add client-side retry (3x exponential), and decide if any routing fields should be required on the form to avoid enrichment dependency for routing. Posting retro invite.

nate: Good. Closing this thread after postmortem note in the playbook: https://redwood.internal/docs/marketing/inbound-sla
